claims: Ezekiel 25:17 is a biblical verse focused on divine vengeance against enemies.

Ezekiel 25:17 in the King James Version (KJV) reads: "And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them".
Ezekiel 25:17 is inaccurately quoted in the film Pulp Fiction.
The King James Version (KJV) of Ezekiel 25:17 focuses on God bringing vengeance on the Philistines.
The Pulp Fiction version of Ezekiel 25:17 is a fictionalized, violent monologue adapted by Quentin Tarantino for the film.
The NASB translation of Ezekiel 25:17 says "I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes...".
